commonPrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished HIGH FIDELITY DESKTOP WEBSITE SECTION for PNPLINE, a Korea-to-USA logistics and US fulfillment business, targeting Simplified Chinese speaking ecommerce sellers. Output ONE landscape 16:9 image, ideally 1920x1080, only the specified section, full flat front-on digital website pixels, no laptop/device/browser chrome, no presentation board, no mockup perspective.
Art direction: ShipMonk-inspired professional logistics marketing design: generous white space, deep navy #182C39 text and dark surfaces, vivid green #19AE49 actions, pale sage #EFF5F1 surfaces, white #FFFFFF, light gray #DAE3DE hairlines. ONE palette throughout the series. Clean geometric sans Latin and precise Noto Sans SC-like Simplified Chinese sans typography, large medium-weight headlines and highly legible supporting copy. Brand wordmark "PNPLINE" in heavy navy/white sans with final "LINE" in green, no invented icon. Containers 28px corners, content modules 20px, buttons 10px rounded rectangles, 64-80px desktop outer gutters. Refined subtle shadow only where needed. Photographic imagery with natural daylight and slightly muted cool-neutral grade; green comes from packaging tape and wayfinding. Accurate readable Chinese text. Sparse professional composition. No neon, purple, orbs, fake KPI stats, testimonials, awards, invented guarantees, unsupported WeChat channel or QR codes. Services start in Korea, not China. All imagery is illustrative concept photography, not documentary evidence. Use natural real photography within the UI, not illustrations unless the section explicitly requests a route schematic.

sections.title: 히어로
sections.body:
Section 1 of 6: HERO ONLY, including the page's main navigation. White page canvas. 88px high polished navigation: PNPLINE at left; spaced labels "物流服务" "解决方案" "数字平台" "关于我们"; right "简体中文" with small chevron and solid green button "获取报价".
Under nav at x50 y130, a large nearly full-width image canvas with 32px rounded corners, ending with 45px white breathing margin. PHOTO-AS-CANVAS composition, not a left text/right image split. A cinematic wide fulfillment warehouse seen down an ordered pick-pack line: clean steel shelves, stacked kraft cartons, green wayfinding on floor, broad roof daylight, packing staff small and incidental deep in right background. Foreground lower right a large cropped kraft shipping box with a single clean vivid green PNPLINE tape band. Perspective route-like floor tape leads through warehouse. Keep the middle upper space a calm deep navy photographic tonal overlay so typography is crystal clear.
Centered above image midpoint, small label "韩国至美国 · 自营海外仓", then two strong headline lines in large white Chinese: "从韩国出发" / "让品牌在美国交付". Below in white, moderate readable size: "头程运输、美国清关、海外仓与订单履约，一站衔接。" Centered solid green primary button "获取美国海外仓报价" and understated white inline secondary link "了解物流方案 ↗". The photo remains visible around and below text, not overloaded. At bottom left INSIDE image put small elegant route caption "INCHEON → CALIFORNIA / TEXAS". Restrained, premium, commercially believable, strong first viewport, no other homepage sections or stat rows.

sections.title: 핵심 서비스
sections.body:
Section 2 of 6: CORE SERVICES ONLY. No global nav or footer. White background, top-left small label "物流服务", very large dark headline "一条链路，覆盖每一步。" Top-right short two-line support "从韩国头程到美国本地交付，\n按业务需求组合物流服务。"
Below this header, one integrated horizontal photograph accordion with four adjacent vertical slices and 18px gaps, 30px outer corners. First active panel occupies about 46% width; three inactive panels share remaining width. 480px tall at reference desktop. 1st: real close-up packing table with kraft parcel green tape and picking aisle behind; lower dark photographic gradient and elegant white title "美国3PL仓储", readable subline "入库 · 拣选打包 · 本地配送", green underlined action "了解仓配服务 ↗". 2nd: cropped cargo plane at airport loading stand under soft daylight, title at bottom "韩国至美国运输" and tiny "海运 / 空运". 3rd: closeup hands examining shipping papers on clean logistics desk, title "美国进口清关", subline "IOR / FDA". 4th: detailed returned product box and handheld barcode scanner on warehouse workbench, title "退货处理", subline "验货 / 换标 / 再入库". The inactive narrow panels still have legible horizontal Chinese titles, not vertical glyphs. Delicate small 01 02 03 04 labels at top-left inside each panel; active first has one small minus button, others have plus in white circle. Distinctive editorial photography and generous outer space. One coherent service-selector section, no separate stacked sections.

sections.title: 한미 물류망
sections.body:
Section 3 of 6: KOREA–USA LOGISTICS NETWORK ONLY. Full-bleed pale sage #EFF5F1 background. A large elegant logistics route schematic is the visual canvas, not a geographically inaccurate ornamental globe. Top-left label "自营仓储网络" and headline on two lines "韩国集货，\n美国自营仓承接。" Supporting line below: "连接仁川与加利福尼亚、德克萨斯，衔接头程、清关与仓配。"
The diagram occupies broad lower and right space. Stylized pale embossed continental silhouettes with PACIFIC-CENTERED orientation: Korea/East Asia on the left, western/central USA on the right. Only exactly three route nodes, accurate general placements: "仁川 · 韩国" on Korean peninsula left, "加利福尼亚 · 美国" on US west coast, and "德克萨斯 · 美国" south-central US. Elegant one vivid green directional curve crosses Pacific from Incheon to California and branches toward Texas, grounded and clean. No China warehouse/origin nodes, no east-coast warehouse, no numerical delivery guarantees.
At lower right a modest pair of rounded horizontal photo crop frames, actual natural-light warehouse aisle and loading dock photos, with clear captions "加利福尼亚自营仓" and "德克萨斯自营仓". At very bottom INSIDE same section a thin itinerary rhythm line, four textual waypoints: "韩国入仓 → 国际运输 → 美国清关 → 仓配履约". Upper right small underlined action "了解仓储网络 ↗". Keep route map clean and unobscured. Subtle narrow editorial side-rail "KOREA → USA" at extreme left once, this is the distinctive secondary-reading motif. Premium credible data-free cartography and spacious type.

sections.title: 판매 채널
sections.body:
Section 4 of 6: SALES CHANNEL SOLUTIONS ONLY. This is the calm mini-minimalist section in the page rhythm. A crisp pure white field, generous top and bottom whitespace. Centered small green label "多渠道履约". Centered navy headline "不同销售渠道，同一个履约伙伴。" Short centered subline "从FBA补货到独立站发货，按渠道需求配置美国仓配。"
Below, at mid height, four airy typographic columns separated by hairline vertical dividers, not boxed cards. Each has a large simple charcoal wordmark followed by two clear short Chinese content lines: column1 "amazon" then "FBA入仓与中转补货" / "FBM订单履约"; column2 "shopify" then "独立站美国本地发货" / "订单与库存协同"; column3 "TikTok Shop" then "美国订单履约" / "拣选、打包与退货"; column4 "B2B / RETAIL" then "美国零售商入仓" / "批量出库与交付". Brands are service categories, no "trusted by" wording or certification badges, do not imply they are PNPLINE clients.
Under columns, one fine baseline, modest underlined green action aligned right "查看渠道解决方案 ↗". No photos needed for this deliberately quieter typography section. Large clear brand names, Chinese text genuinely readable. This should feel like a premium website's spacious channel routing component, not a logo ticker, four feature cards, or an infographic slide.

sections.title: 운영 시스템
sections.body:
Section 5 of 6: DIGITAL LOGISTICS PLATFORM ONLY. Pale sage #EFF5F1 page surface. Inverted editorial composition: left 62% large purposeful product UI preview, right 32% short messaging. No nav/footer. Left main UI is a straight-on white WMS interface panel with 20px corners and subtle shadow, slightly bleeding toward left viewport edge but still readable. Not a computer frame. Top bar "PNPLINE WMS", small "库存与出库". Navy thin left sidebar, highlighted green "库存管理", other sidebar items "入库管理" "出库管理" "退货管理". Table header "商品" "仓库" "库存状态" with only THREE realistic rows: "护肤套装" / "加利福尼亚" / "可出库"; "服装配件" / "德克萨斯" / "待检验"; "家居用品" / "加利福尼亚" / "可出库". Product thumbnails tiny and neutral. No random numbers, charts, fake statistics. Below table a simple purposeful shipping stage row "订单接收 → 拣选打包 → 出库配送". At lower-right edge of preview a single small overlapping detail card "出库指令" with text "选择库存，确认发货。" and green action "创建出库". Small subdued caption under preview "界面示意" to make concept status clear.
Right text block vertically centered: green small label "数字物流平台". Navy strong headline with three balanced short lines "库存、订单、出库，\n清楚掌握。" Support: "通过WMS查看库存、跟踪入出库，\n并管理发货与退货。" Below three clean separated list rows with slim green indicators: "仓库管理 WMS" / "海运订舱与追踪" / "空运订单管理". Bottom outlined navy rectangular CTA "了解数字平台 ↗". Make this genuinely buildable high-end marketing product section, varied rhythm, excellent whitespace, no marketing KPI decoration.

sections.title: 견적 상담
sections.body:
Section 6 of 6: FINAL QUOTE CONVERSION SECTION ONLY. Deep navy #182C39 full background, subtle natural photographic macro of neatly sealed kraft parcel with a vivid green tape band under dark navy grade across left half, not a new palette. Spacious elegant classic asymmetric 45/55 composition. Left large white headline "从下一批货，\n开始规划美国物流。" Small green label "获取物流方案". White concise support "告诉我们服务需求与业务规模，\n获取适合您的运输和仓配方案。" Then three modest readable checklist lines "韩国至美国运输" "美国海外仓与FBA入仓" "清关、配送与退货". At bottom left real known business contact "korea@pnpline.com", no invented address, no QR code, no WeChat claim.
Right a large white panel with 28px rounded corners and generous 36px internal padding, heading "获取美国物流报价". This is a SHORT HOMEPAGE lead-in form design, not exact full existing quote page. Label "所需服务" with three clean selectable choices "美国3PL" "FBA入仓" "海运 / 空运". A two-column input row with visible labels "公司名称" and "联系人"; next full width input "工作邮箱"; next select "月均业务量" with placeholder "请选择". A small unselected privacy checkbox and label "我已阅读并同意隐私政策". A single full-width solid green CTA "获取定制报价 →". No form values or fake response-time promises. Tiny muted supporting note "费用以货物信息和实际方案为准。"
At the very bottom a discreet integrated footer baseline within this same conversion section, white PNPLINE wordmark on left, "物流服务   数字平台   关于我们   隐私政策" right. Do not make a second full footer section. Commercially mature bright form/dark visual balance, clear final conversion target, precision grid and readable Chinese.
